items.html: And behold, the matter of the correction and the growth is in this manner. For behold, in the first two years, called the two years of Yenika, then his two brains grew, and they are his Hochma and Bina, as above. But Daat is not needed by him now; and it will grow afterward in the second Ibur of Mochin, fit to give birth, as mentioned there. And it is found that even these two brains were corrected only in the aspect of growth alone, and not that they are now fit to give birth.
